title: Implant starts working after Anne's death and spells out 'it's me'

tellings.quote: And the words slow down and it says very clearly coming across, it's me and

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber says that after his wife Anne Strieber died in 2015, a small object he believes was implanted in his body began to work, and sent him words that slowed down and spelled out "it's me." He tells it as something he lived through himself. If true, it would mean his wife was reaching him after death through that implant.
